verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents securing your own API with OAuth 2.0 and issuing access tokens to registered clients via Client Credentials and Device Authorization flows. Its access-management page mentions scopes and granular permissions for "third-party integrations," which suggests your app's API can authorize outside clients through Auth0. However, the pack never explicitly describes a "Sign in with my app" provider setup. Missing for 10: explicit docs on registering third-party (non-first-party) applications, user consent screens for third-party clients, dynamic client registration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
